title: M2 · The shared “are you sure?” box — mockup
subtitle: One box for every section (rulebook v1.008 with D1a–D1d and D10a). The button that changes nothing on the left, saying what stays; the action on the right repeating the words pressed — red when it loses something for good. Amber outline = what the shared box decides. The 320 column shows the stacked buttons (D1b) and, at 640 tall, no pinned button row.
